statement: 在整个7周试验期间，所有实验组鲫鱼的存活率均为100%。
text_zh: 在整个7周试验期间，所有实验组鲫鱼的存活率均为100%。
text_en: During the entire 7-week trial period, the survival rate of crucian carp in all experimental groups was 100%.

quote: The dose–effect relationship between AMPs content and SGR (quadratic polynomial fit) is displayed in Figure 1 . Therefore, under the experimental conditions, the optimal dosage of growth-promoting AMPs was determined to be 0.241 g/kg.
statement: 在实验条件下，抗菌肽（AMPs）促进生长的最佳剂量被确定为0.241 g/kg。
text_zh: 在实验条件下，抗菌肽（AMPs）促进生长的最佳剂量被确定为0.241 g/kg。
text_en: Under experimental conditions, the optimal dose of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) for promoting growth was determined to be 0.241 g/kg.

quote: Catalase (CAT) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) activities were measured using assay kits (Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute, Nanjing, China).
statement: 过氧化氢酶（CAT）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性使用试剂盒进行测定。
text_zh: 过氧化氢酶（CAT）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性使用试剂盒进行测定。
text_en: The activities of catalase (CAT) and superoxide dismutase (SOD) were determined using kits.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Malondialdehyde (MDA) content was quantified via thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) assay.
statement: 丙二醛（MDA）含量通过硫代巴比妥酸反应物（TBARS）法进行定量。
text_zh: 丙二醛（MDA）含量通过硫代巴比妥酸反应物（TBARS）法进行定量。
text_en: Malondialdehyde (MDA) content was quantified by the thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) method.

quote: The levels of cytokines (C3, C4, IL-1, IL-6, IL-12, TNF-α, and IFN-γ) in the serum were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).
statement: 血清中细胞因子（C3、C4、IL-1、IL-6、IL-12、TNF-α和IFN-γ）的水平通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）进行测量。
text_zh: 血清中细胞因子（C3、C4、IL-1、IL-6、IL-12、TNF-α和IFN-γ）的水平通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）进行测量。
text_en: The levels of cytokines in serum (C3, C4, IL-1, IL-6, IL-12, TNF-α and IFN-γ) were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).

quote: oups L1 and L2 was significantly increased compared to group L0 (p p p Figure 3 Effects of AMPs on immune-related enzyme activities in the serum of crucian carp. (A): ACP activity, (B): AKP activity, (C): LZM activity.
statement: 与对照组L0相比，L1和L2组血清中免疫相关酶（ACP、AKP、LZM）活性显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组L0相比，L1和L2组血清中免疫相关酶（ACP、AKP、LZM）活性显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group L0, the activities of immune-related enzymes (ACP, AKP, LZM) in serum were significantly increased in groups L1 and L2.

quote: The C3 content of groups L1, L2, and L3 was significantly higher compared to group L0 (p p p p p Figure 4 Effects of AMPs on immune factors in serum from crucian carp. (A): C3 content,
statement: 与对照组L0相比，L1、L2和L3组血清中C3含量显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组L0相比，L1、L2和L3组血清中C3含量显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group L0, serum C3 content was significantly increased in groups L1, L2 and L3.

quote: Compared to group L0, the relative mRNA expression levels of key genes (TLR4 , MyD88 , IRAK4 , TRAF6 , and NF-KB) of groups L1, L2, and L3 were significantly upregulated (p Figure 5 Effects of AMPs on relative expression levels of key genes in the liver tissue of crucian carp.
statement: 与对照组L0相比，L1、L2和L3组肝脏组织中关键基因（TLR4, MyD88, IRAK4, TRAF6, NF-KB）的相对mRNA表达水平显著上调。
text_zh: 与对照组L0相比，L1、L2和L3组肝脏组织中关键基因（TLR4, MyD88, IRAK4, TRAF6, NF-KB）的相对mRNA表达水平显著上调。
text_en: Compared with the control group L0, the relative mRNA expression levels of key genes (TLR4, MyD88, IRAK4, TRAF6, NF-KB) in liver tissue were significantly upregulated in groups L1, L2 and L3.

quote: Supplementation of 0.2–0.6 g/kg AMPs per diet significantly elevated serum IL-1 levels, while the highest dose (0.6 g/kg) significantly reduced serum interleukin-6 (IL-6) and interleukin-12 (IL-12) levels.
statement: 每千克饲料添加0.2至0.6克抗菌肽显著提高了血清白细胞介素-1水平，而最高剂量（0.6克/千克）显著降低了血清白细胞介素-6和白细胞介素-12水平。
text_zh: 每千克饲料添加0.2至0.6克抗菌肽显著提高了血清白细胞介素-1水平，而最高剂量（0.6克/千克）显著降低了血清白细胞介素-6和白细胞介素-12水平。
text_en: Supplementation with 0.2 to 0.6 grams of antimicrobial peptides per kilogram of feed significantly increased serum interleukin-1 levels, while the highest dose (0.6 g/kg) significantly decreased serum interleukin-6 and interleukin-12 levels.

quote: Importantly, all tested AMP concentrations (0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 g/kg) effectively enhanced both IFN-γ and TNF-α production in serum, suggesting a potent immunostimulatory capacity of AMPs.
statement: 所有测试的抗菌肽浓度（0.2、0.4和0.6克/千克）均有效增强了血清中干扰素-γ和肿瘤坏死因子-α的产生，表明抗菌肽具有强大的免疫刺激能力。
text_zh: 所有测试的抗菌肽浓度（0.2、0.4和0.6克/千克）均有效增强了血清中干扰素-γ和肿瘤坏死因子-α的产生，表明抗菌肽具有强大的免疫刺激能力。
text_en: All tested antimicrobial peptide concentrations (0.2, 0.4 and 0.6 g/kg) effectively enhanced the production of interferon-γ and tumor necrosis factor-α in serum, indicating that antimicrobial peptides have strong immunostimulatory capacity.

quote: This study demonstrated that dietary supplementation with 0.2 g/kg AMPs increased SOD and CAT activities, reduced serum MDA content, thereby enhancing the antioxidant capacity of crucian carp.
statement: 本研究表明，日粮中添加0.2 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）增加了SOD和CAT活性，降低了血清MDA含量，从而增强了鲫鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 本研究表明，日粮中添加0.2 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）增加了SOD和CAT活性，降低了血清MDA含量，从而增强了鲫鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_en: This study showed that dietary supplementation with 0.2 g/kg of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) increased SOD and CAT activities and decreased serum MDA content, thereby enhancing the antioxidant capacity of crucian carp.

quote: These findings are consistent with previous studies in zebrafish [ 22 ], grass carp [ 37 ], and grouper [ 38 ], suggesting that AMPs improve antioxidant responses and may mitigate immune stress.
statement: 这些发现与斑马鱼、草鱼和石斑鱼之前的研究一致，表明AMPs能改善抗氧化反应并可能减轻免疫应激。
text_zh: 这些发现与斑马鱼、草鱼和石斑鱼之前的研究一致，表明AMPs能改善抗氧化反应并可能减轻免疫应激。
text_en: These findings are consistent with previous studies on zebrafish, grass carp and grouper, indicating that AMPs improve antioxidant responses and may alleviate immune stress.

quote: The SOD activity of group L1 was significantly higher compared to groups L0, L2, and L3 (p p p Figure 2 Effects of AMPs on antioxidant abilities in the serum of crucian carp.
statement: L1组血清超氧化物歧化酶活性显著高于对照组及其他处理组。
text_zh: L1组血清超氧化物歧化酶活性显著高于对照组及其他处理组。
text_en: Serum superoxide dismutase activity in the L1 group was significantly higher than that in the control group and other treatment groups.

quote: In this experiment, supplementation with 0.2 g/kg AMPs significantly elevated the ACP, AKP, and lysozyme activities in the serum of crucian carp.
statement: 在本实验中，添加0.2 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）显著提高了鲫鱼血清中的酸性磷酸酶（ACP）、碱性磷酸酶（AKP）和溶菌酶活性。
text_zh: 在本实验中，添加0.2 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）显著提高了鲫鱼血清中的酸性磷酸酶（ACP）、碱性磷酸酶（AKP）和溶菌酶活性。
text_en: In this experiment, the addition of 0.2 g/kg antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) significantly increased acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP), and lysozyme activities in the serum of crucian carp.

quote: These findings on common carp [ 15 ] and eel [ 44 ] exhibit congruent patterns with the present experimental data.
statement: 这些发现与普通鲤鱼[15]和鳗鱼[44]的研究结果表现出一致的模式。
text_zh: 这些发现与普通鲤鱼[15]和鳗鱼[44]的研究结果表现出一致的模式。
text_en: These findings show a consistent pattern with the results of studies on common carp [15] and eel [44].

quote: AKP activity exhibited a decline when supplemented with 0.6 g/kg AMPs.
statement: 当添加0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽时，碱性磷酸酶（AKP）活性出现下降。
text_zh: 当添加0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽时，碱性磷酸酶（AKP）活性出现下降。
text_en: When 0.6 g/kg of antimicrobial peptides was added, alkaline phosphatase (AKP) activity decreased.

quote: This may be due to the excessive AMPs, which may impose a burden on the liver and intestines, resulting in reduced AKP activity.
statement: 这可能是由于过量的抗菌肽可能对肝脏和肠道造成负担，从而导致AKP活性降低。
text_zh: 这可能是由于过量的抗菌肽可能对肝脏和肠道造成负担，从而导致AKP活性降低。
text_en: This may be due to excessive antimicrobial peptides potentially burdening the liver and intestine, leading to reduced AKP activity.

quote: However, when AMP concentrations exceed a critical threshold, they bind to all anionic membranes (including those of beneficial gut microbiota and host intestinal epithelial cells) via electrostatic interactions.
statement: 然而，当抗菌肽浓度超过临界阈值时，它们通过静电相互作用结合所有阴离子膜（包括有益肠道微生物群和宿主肠上皮细胞的膜）。
text_zh: 然而，当抗菌肽浓度超过临界阈值时，它们通过静电相互作用结合所有阴离子膜（包括有益肠道微生物群和宿主肠上皮细胞的膜）。
text_en: However, when the concentration of antimicrobial peptides exceeds a critical threshold, they bind to all anionic membranes (including those of beneficial gut microbiota and host intestinal epithelial cells) through electrostatic interactions.
outcome: 肠道屏障完整性/菌群平衡

quote: This leads to membrane disruption, ultimately destabilizing the intestinal flora equilibrium and impairing nutrient absorption, which inhibits growth.
statement: 这导致膜破坏，最终破坏肠道菌群平衡并损害营养吸收，从而抑制生长。
text_zh: 这导致膜破坏，最终破坏肠道菌群平衡并损害营养吸收，从而抑制生长。
text_en: This leads to membrane disruption, ultimately disrupting the balance of gut microbiota and impairing nutrient absorption, thereby inhibiting growth.

quote: Analysis of visceral organ weight and visceral somatic index revealed no significant adverse effects of AMPs on the internal organs of crucian carp, consistent with previous findings reported by Dong et al. [ 18 ].
statement: 对内脏重量和内脏体指数的分析显示，抗菌肽对鲫鱼的内脏器官没有显著的负面影响，这与Dong等人之前报道的结果一致。
text_zh: 对内脏重量和内脏体指数的分析显示，抗菌肽对鲫鱼的内脏器官没有显著的负面影响，这与Dong等人之前报道的结果一致。
text_en: Analysis of visceral weight and viscerosomatic index showed that antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) had no significant negative effect on the visceral organs of crucian carp, which is consistent with the results previously reported by Dong et al.

quote: Prolonged or excessive AMP exposure may therefore lead to excessive complement consumption and cytokine storms, potentially causing tissue damage.
statement: 长时间或过量的抗菌肽暴露可能导致补体过度消耗和细胞因子风暴，从而潜在地造成组织损伤。
text_zh: 长时间或过量的抗菌肽暴露可能导致补体过度消耗和细胞因子风暴，从而潜在地造成组织损伤。
text_en: Prolonged or excessive exposure to antimicrobial peptides may lead to excessive complement consumption and cytokine storms, thereby potentially causing tissue damage.

quote: This underscores the importance of strictly controlling AMP additive doses in aquaculture practices—balancing effective immune activation with the avoidance of harmful inflammatory overactivation.
statement: 这强调了在水产养殖实践中严格控制抗菌肽添加剂量的重要性，即在有效免疫激活与避免有害炎症过度激活之间取得平衡。
text_zh: 这强调了在水产养殖实践中严格控制抗菌肽添加剂量的重要性，即在有效免疫激活与避免有害炎症过度激活之间取得平衡。
text_en: This emphasizes the importance of strictly controlling AMP additive doses in aquaculture practices, namely achieving a balance between effective immune activation and avoiding excessive harmful inflammation.

quote: They also demonstrate lower cytotoxicity towards non-target organisms (e.g., farmed fish) [ 68 ].
statement: 抗菌肽对非靶标生物（如养殖鱼类）表现出较低的细胞毒性。
text_zh: 抗菌肽对非靶标生物（如养殖鱼类）表现出较低的细胞毒性。
text_en: Antimicrobial peptides exhibit low cytotoxicity to non-target organisms (such as farmed fish).

quote: According to previous research, AMPs have been found to promote the growth of aquatic organisms and enhance both specific and non-specific immunity, thereby improving disease resistance [ 21 , 22 ].
statement: 根据先前的研究，抗菌肽（AMPs）被发现能促进水生生物的生长并增强特异性和非特异性免疫，从而提高抗病力。
text_zh: 根据先前的研究，抗菌肽（AMPs）被发现能促进水生生物的生长并增强特异性和非特异性免疫，从而提高抗病力。
text_en: According to previous studies, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have been found to promote the growth of aquatic organisms and enhance specific and non-specific immunity, thereby improving disease resistance.
outcome: 生长性能与免疫抗病力

quote: The addition of cecropin improved the growth performance and non-specific immunity, enhanced disease resistance against Aeromonas species infection in tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus × O.aureus) [ 23 ].
statement: 添加天蚕素改善了罗非鱼的生长性能和非特异性免疫，并增强了对气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: 添加天蚕素改善了罗非鱼的生长性能和非特异性免疫，并增强了对气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_en: Adding cecropin improved the growth performance and non-specific immunity of tilapia, and enhanced resistance to Aeromonas infection.
outcome: 生长性能、免疫及抗病力

quote: Similarly, Jan [ 25 ] found that a dietary AMP concentration of 0.8 g/kg significantly improved the growth performance and survival rate of swamp eels.
statement: Jan发现，日粮中0.8 g/kg的抗菌肽浓度显著提高了黄鳝的生长性能和存活率。
text_zh: Jan发现，日粮中0.8 g/kg的抗菌肽浓度显著提高了黄鳝的生长性能和存活率。
text_en: Jan found that a dietary concentration of 0.8 g/kg antimicrobial peptides significantly improved the growth performance and survival rate of ricefield eels.

quote: Our results indicated that when the diet was supplemented with AMPs at 0.241 g/kg, crucian carp achieved the best growth rate, whereas concentrations exceeding this level appeared to inhibit growth (compared to the control group).
statement: 本研究结果显示，当日粮中添加0.241 g/kg的抗菌肽时，鲫鱼达到最佳生长速率，而超过该水平的浓度似乎抑制了生长。
text_zh: 本研究结果显示，当日粮中添加0.241 g/kg的抗菌肽时，鲫鱼达到最佳生长速率，而超过该水平的浓度似乎抑制了生长。
text_en: The results of this study showed that crucian carp achieved the best growth rate when 0.241 g/kg of antimicrobial peptides was added to the diet, while concentrations above this level appeared to inhibit growth.

quote: However, short-chain bioactive peptides exhibited negligible effects on growth parameters in zebrafish [ 22 ].
statement: 然而，短链生物活性肽对斑马鱼生长参数的影响微乎其微。
text_zh: 然而，短链生物活性肽对斑马鱼生长参数的影响微乎其微。
text_en: However, the effect of short-chain bioactive peptides on zebrafish growth parameters was negligible.

quote: Notably, excessive AMP concentrations may suppress growth, likely due to dose-dependent disruption of intestinal microbiota balance.
statement: 值得注意的是，过量的抗菌肽浓度可能会抑制生长，这可能是由于剂量依赖性地破坏了肠道微生物群平衡。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，过量的抗菌肽浓度可能会抑制生长，这可能是由于剂量依赖性地破坏了肠道微生物群平衡。
text_en: It is worth noting that excessive concentrations of antimicrobial peptides may inhibit growth, possibly due to the dose-dependent disruption of gut microbiota balance.
outcome: 生长性能与肠道菌群平衡

quote: Further studies demonstrated that AMPs modulated intestinal motility and differentially influenced the colonization of pathogenic versus probiotic bacteria in fish under varied aquaculture conditions [ 28 ].
statement: 进一步的研究表明，在不同的养殖条件下，抗菌肽调节鱼类肠道蠕动，并对致病菌和益生菌的定植产生差异化影响。
text_zh: 进一步的研究表明，在不同的养殖条件下，抗菌肽调节鱼类肠道蠕动，并对致病菌和益生菌的定植产生差异化影响。
text_en: Further research indicates that under different farming conditions, antimicrobial peptides regulate fish intestinal peristalsis and have differentiated effects on the colonization of pathogenic bacteria and probiotics.

quote: This dual modulation indicates that AMPs mitigate immunosuppression induced by oxidative stress.
statement: The dual modulation of immune responses suggests that antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) reduce immunosuppression caused by oxidative stress.
text_en: The dual modulation of immune responses suggests that antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) reduce immunosuppression caused by oxidative stress.

quote: Notably, the identified optimal dose range (0.2–0.4 g/kg of diet) balances immune stimulation while avoiding the NF-κB overactivation observed in other teleost species at higher AMP doses.
statement: The optimal dose range of 0.2–0.4 g/kg of diet balances immune stimulation and avoids NF-κB overactivation seen in other teleosts at higher doses.
text_en: The optimal dose range of 0.2–0.4 g/kg of diet balances immune stimulation and avoids NF-κB overactivation seen in other teleosts at higher doses.

quote: This finding provides practical guidance for the application of AMPs as feed additives in freshwater cyprinid farming.
statement: The findings offer practical guidance for using AMPs as feed additives in freshwater cyprinid farming.
text_en: The findings offer practical guidance for using AMPs as feed additives in freshwater cyprinid farming.

quote: Addressing these bottlenecks, such as developing microbial fermentation technologies or designing microencapsulation AMPs to enhance stability, will be pivotal for antibiotic-free aquaculture.
statement: 解决这些瓶颈，例如开发微生物发酵技术或设计微胶囊化抗菌肽以增强稳定性，对于无抗生素水产养殖至关重要。
text_zh: 解决这些瓶颈，例如开发微生物发酵技术或设计微胶囊化抗菌肽以增强稳定性，对于无抗生素水产养殖至关重要。
text_en: Addressing these bottlenecks, such as developing microbial fermentation technology or designing microencapsulated antimicrobial peptides to enhance stability, is crucial for antibiotic-free aquaculture.

quote: Overall, dietary supplementation with AMPs at 0.2–0.4 g/kg of diet optimally enhances growth performance and muscle quality in crucian carp, while exhibiting no adverse effects on visceral organs.
statement: 总体而言，日粮中添加0.2–0.4 g/kg的抗菌肽能最佳地提高鲫鱼的生长性能和肌肉品质，同时对内脏器官没有不利影响。
text_zh: 总体而言，日粮中添加0.2–0.4 g/kg的抗菌肽能最佳地提高鲫鱼的生长性能和肌肉品质，同时对内脏器官没有不利影响。
text_en: Overall, dietary supplementation with 0.2–0.4 g/kg of antimicrobial peptides optimally improves the growth performance and muscle quality of crucian carp, without adverse effects on visceral organs.
outcome: 生长性能; 肌肉品质; 内脏健康

quote: The findings reveal three novel mechanisms: first, AMPs uniquely synchronize growth promotion (via improving nutrient absorption efficiency) and immune enhancement—a contrast to conventional additives that often prioritize single outcomes.
statement: 研究结果揭示了三个新机制：首先，抗菌肽独特地同步了促进生长（通过提高营养吸收效率）和增强免疫——这与通常优先考虑单一结果的常规添加剂形成对比。
text_zh: 研究结果揭示了三个新机制：首先，抗菌肽独特地同步了促进生长（通过提高营养吸收效率）和增强免疫——这与通常优先考虑单一结果的常规添加剂形成对比。
text_en: The research results revealed three new mechanisms: first, antimicrobial peptides uniquely synchronized growth promotion (through improved nutrient absorption efficiency) and immune enhancement—contrasting with conventional additives that typically prioritize a single outcome.
outcome: 生长性能; 免疫功能

quote: Second, the unchanged hepatosomatic index confirms visceral organ safety at the identified effective dose range (0.2–0.4 g/kg).
statement: 其次，肝体指数保持不变证实了在确定的有效剂量范围（0.2–0.4 g/kg）内的内脏器官安全性。
text_zh: 其次，肝体指数保持不变证实了在确定的有效剂量范围（0.2–0.4 g/kg）内的内脏器官安全性。
text_en: Secondly, the unchanged hepatosomatic index confirms visceral organ safety within the established effective dose range (0.2–0.4 g/kg).

quote: Third, AMPs elevate systemic antioxidant capacity (via increasing SOD activity) while activating the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and inducing secretion of proinflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α).
statement: 第三，抗菌肽提高了全身抗氧化能力（通过增加SOD活性），同时激活TLR4/NF-κB通路并诱导促炎细胞因子（IL-6, TNF-α）的分泌。
text_zh: 第三，抗菌肽提高了全身抗氧化能力（通过增加SOD活性），同时激活TLR4/NF-κB通路并诱导促炎细胞因子（IL-6, TNF-α）的分泌。
text_en: Third, antimicrobial peptides improved systemic antioxidant capacity (by increasing SOD activity), while simultaneously activating the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and inducing the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α).
outcome: 抗氧化能力; 炎症反应
counterevidence: 诱导促炎细胞因子分泌可能被视为负面效应，尽管作者将其解释为缓解免疫抑制的一部分

quote: Our study reveals that dietary supplementation with 0.2–0.6 g/kg diet of AMPs in crucian carp elicits a dual upregulation of mRNA and protein expression levels of key components in the TLR4 signaling cascade—including TLR4, IRAK4, MyD88, TRAF6, and NF-κB—in hepatic tissues.
statement: 本研究显示，在鲫鱼饲料中添加0.2–0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）可诱导肝脏组织中TLR4信号通路关键组分（包括TLR4、IRAK4、MyD88、TRAF6和NF-κB）的mRNA和蛋白表达水平双重上调。
text_zh: 本研究显示，在鲫鱼饲料中添加0.2–0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽（AMPs）可诱导肝脏组织中TLR4信号通路关键组分（包括TLR4、IRAK4、MyD88、TRAF6和NF-κB）的mRNA和蛋白表达水平双重上调。
text_en: This study showed that adding 0.2–0.6 g/kg of antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) to crucian carp feed induced a dual upregulation of mRNA and protein expression levels of key components of the TLR4 signaling pathway in liver tissue, including TLR4, IRAK4, MyD88, TRAF6, and NF-κB.
outcome: 免疫基因表达与信号通路激活

quote: In addition, the abundance of the genus Vibrio in 3nCC was increased compared to 2nCC (P NLRP3 , LY9 , PNMA1 , MR1 , PELI1 , NOTCH2 , NFIL3, and NLRC4 .
statement: 此外，与二倍体相比，3nCC中弧菌属的丰度增加（涉及NLRP3、LY9等基因）。
text_zh: 此外，与二倍体相比，3nCC中弧菌属的丰度增加（涉及NLRP3、LY9等基因）。
text_en: In addition, compared with diploids, the abundance of Vibrio in 3nCC increased (involving genes such as NLRP3 and LY9).

quote: For instance, in Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar L.), triploids may be at a disadvantage compared with their diploid siblings in their defense against bacterial infections [ 2 ].
statement: 例如，在大西洋鲑鱼中，三倍体在抵御细菌感染方面可能比其二倍体同胞处于劣势。
text_zh: 例如，在大西洋鲑鱼中，三倍体在抵御细菌感染方面可能比其二倍体同胞处于劣势。
text_en: For example, in Atlantic salmon, triploids may be at a disadvantage compared to their diploid siblings in resisting bacterial infections.

quote: in response to a challenge with Vibrio anguillarum , the mortality of triploid Chinook salmon (Oncorhynchus tshawytscha) increased
statement: 在受到鳗弧菌攻击时，三倍体奇努克鲑的死亡率增加。
text_zh: 在受到鳗弧菌攻击时，三倍体奇努克鲑的死亡率增加。
text_en: When attacked by Vibrio anguillarum, the mortality rate of triploid Chinook salmon increases.

quote: triploid oysters have higher disease resistance than diploids, as observed in Crassostrea virginica and Saccostrea glomerata
statement: 在Crassostrea virginica和Saccostrea glomerata中观察到，三倍体牡蛎比二倍体具有更高的抗病力。
text_zh: 在Crassostrea virginica和Saccostrea glomerata中观察到，三倍体牡蛎比二倍体具有更高的抗病力。
text_en: In Crassostrea virginica and Saccostrea glomerata, triploid oysters were observed to have higher disease resistance than diploids.

quote: In fertile triploid fish, normal gonadal development causes the energy needed for somatic growth to be channeled into gamete production. Consequently, this results in adverse effects, including poor physical growth and flesh quality, and can increase mortality and morbidity rates
statement: 在可育的三倍体鱼中，正常的性腺发育导致用于体细胞生长的能量被转移到配子产生中，从而造成生长不良、肉质差以及死亡率和发病率增加等不利影响。
text_zh: 在可育的三倍体鱼中，正常的性腺发育导致用于体细胞生长的能量被转移到配子产生中，从而造成生长不良、肉质差以及死亡率和发病率增加等不利影响。
text_en: In fertile triploid fish, normal gonadal development diverts energy used for somatic growth into gamete production, resulting in adverse effects such as poor growth, inferior flesh quality, and increased mortality and morbidity.

quote: Meng et al. [ 47 ] demonstrated that elevated serum C3 levels enhance resistance to secondary infections in grass carp.
statement: Meng等人[47]证明，草鱼血清C3水平升高可增强对继发感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: Meng等人[47]证明，草鱼血清C3水平升高可增强对继发感染的抵抗力。
text_en: Meng et al. [47] demonstrated that elevated serum C3 levels in grass carp can enhance resistance to secondary infections.

quote: He considered that the serum C3 quantification could serve as a diagnostic biomarker for disease status assessment.
statement: 他认为血清C3定量可作为疾病状态评估的诊断生物标志物。
text_zh: 他认为血清C3定量可作为疾病状态评估的诊断生物标志物。
text_en: He considered serum C3 quantification as a diagnostic biomarker for assessing disease status.

quote: Our experimental results demonstrated that dietary supplementation with AMPs at 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 g/kg significantly increased serum complement component C3 content in crucian carp, and doses of 0.4 and 0.6 g/kg additionally elevated serum C4 content.
statement: 实验结果表明，日粮中添加0.2、0.4和0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽显著增加了鲫鱼血清补体成分C3的含量，且0.4和0.6 g/kg的剂量还提高了血清C4含量。
text_zh: 实验结果表明，日粮中添加0.2、0.4和0.6 g/kg的抗菌肽显著增加了鲫鱼血清补体成分C3的含量，且0.4和0.6 g/kg的剂量还提高了血清C4含量。
text_en: Experimental results showed that dietary supplementation with antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) at 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 g/kg significantly increased the content of serum complement component C3 in crucian carp, and doses of 0.4 and 0.6 g/kg also improved serum C4 content.

quote: This is consistent with the experimental results that antimicrobial peptides induced by Hermetia illucens can increase the complement C3 content in the serum of common carp [ 48 ].
statement: 这与黑水虻诱导的抗菌肽可以增加鲤鱼血清中补体C3含量的实验结果一致[48]。
text_zh: 这与黑水虻诱导的抗菌肽可以增加鲤鱼血清中补体C3含量的实验结果一致[48]。
text_en: This is consistent with the experimental result that black soldier fly-induced antimicrobial peptides can increase the complement C3 content in carp serum [48].

quote: Elevated TNF-α further strengthens the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway via positive feedback mechanisms, enhancing endothelial adhesion molecule expression and neutrophil/macrophage recruitment.
statement: 升高的TNF-α通过正反馈机制进一步增强TLR4/NF-κB信号通路，增强内皮粘附分子表达以及中性粒细胞/巨噬细胞的募集。
text_zh: 升高的TNF-α通过正反馈机制进一步增强TLR4/NF-κB信号通路，增强内皮粘附分子表达以及中性粒细胞/巨噬细胞的募集。
text_en: Elevated TNF-α further enhances the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway through a positive feedback mechanism, increasing endothelial adhesion molecule expression and neutrophil/macrophage recruitment.

quote: This mechanism ultimately enhances macrophage M1 polarization and antimicrobial capabilities.
statement: 该机制最终增强巨噬细胞M1极化和抗菌能力。
text_zh: 该机制最终增强巨噬细胞M1极化和抗菌能力。
text_en: This mechanism ultimately enhances macrophage M1 polarization and antibacterial capacity.

quote: On an order level (Table 2), Vibrionales greatly increased in abundance in the triploid population (P
statement: 在目水平上，三倍体群体中弧菌目（Vibrionales）的丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 在目水平上，三倍体群体中弧菌目（Vibrionales）的丰度显著增加。
text_en: At the order level, the abundance of Vibrionales significantly increased in triploid populations.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成/潜在病原菌丰度

quote: a significant improvement in Vibrionaceae relative abundance was associated with triploidization (P
statement: 弧菌科（Vibrionaceae）相对丰度的显著变化与三倍体化有关。
text_zh: 弧菌科（Vibrionaceae）相对丰度的显著变化与三倍体化有关。
text_en: Significant changes in the relative abundance of Vibrionaceae are associated with triploidization.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成/潜在病原菌丰度

quote: Vibrio became more prevalent in 3nCC (P
statement: 弧菌属（Vibrio）在三倍体鲫鱼（3nCC）中更为普遍。
text_zh: 弧菌属（Vibrio）在三倍体鲫鱼（3nCC）中更为普遍。
text_en: Vibrio species are more prevalent in triploid crucian carp (3nCC).
outcome: 肠道菌群组成/潜在病原菌丰度

quote: the relative abundance of uncultured_bacterium_g_ Vibrio was significantly increased by triploidization (P
statement: 未培养细菌属_弧菌（uncultured_bacterium_g_Vibrio）的相对丰度因三倍体化而显著增加。
text_zh: 未培养细菌属_弧菌（uncultured_bacterium_g_Vibrio）的相对丰度因三倍体化而显著增加。
text_en: The relative abundance of uncultured_bacterium_g_Vibrio significantly increased due to triploidization.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成/潜在病原菌丰度

quote: Oxidative stress and antioxidant defense in fish: The implications of probiotic, prebiotic, and synbiotics.
statement: 该文献综述探讨了益生菌、益生元和合生元对鱼类氧化应激和抗氧化防御的影响。
text_zh: 该文献综述探讨了益生菌、益生元和合生元对鱼类氧化应激和抗氧化防御的影响。
text_en: This literature review explores the effects of probiotics, prebiotics, and synbiotics on oxidative stress and antioxidant defense in fish.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化防御

quote: Growth performance, haematological changes, immune response, antioxidant activity and disease resistance in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) fed diet supplemented with ellagic acid.
statement: 该研究报告了在虹鳟饲料中添加鞣花酸对其生长性能、血液学变化、免疫反应、抗氧化活性和抗病力的影响。
text_zh: 该研究报告了在虹鳟饲料中添加鞣花酸对其生长性能、血液学变化、免疫反应、抗氧化活性和抗病力的影响。
text_en: The study reported the effects of adding ellagic acid to rainbow trout feed on its growth performance, hematological changes, immune response, antioxidant activity, and disease resistance.
outcome: 生长性能、血液学变化、免疫反应、抗氧化活性和抗病力

quote: Effects of dietary antimicrobial peptides on intestinal morphology, antioxidant status, immune responses, microbiota and pathogen disease resistance in grass carp Ctenopharyngodon idellus.
statement: 该研究考察了饲料中添加抗菌肽对草鱼肠道形态、抗氧化状态、免疫反应、微生物群和病原抗病力的影响。
text_zh: 该研究考察了饲料中添加抗菌肽对草鱼肠道形态、抗氧化状态、免疫反应、微生物群和病原抗病力的影响。
text_en: This study examined the effects of dietary supplementation with antimicrobial peptides on intestinal morphology, antioxidant status, immune response, microbiota, and disease resistance against pathogens in grass carp.
outcome: 肠道形态、抗氧化状态、免疫反应、微生物群和病原抗病力

quote: Impact of Tilapia hepcidin 2-3 dietary supplementation on the gut microbiota profile and immunomodulation in the grouper (Epinephelus lanceolatus)
statement: 该研究关注饲料中添加罗非鱼hepcidin 2-3对石斑鱼肠道微生物群组成和免疫调节的影响。
text_zh: 该研究关注饲料中添加罗非鱼hepcidin 2-3对石斑鱼肠道微生物群组成和免疫调节的影响。
text_en: This study focuses on the effects of dietary supplementation with tilapia hepcidin 2-3 on the gut microbiota composition and immune regulation of grouper.
outcome: 肠道微生物群组成和免疫调节

quote: It has been demonstrated that Se-rich B. subtilis improves intestinal microbial changes induced by Hg, reduces Aeromonas abundance and inflammation in common carp [ 18 ].
statement: 富硒枯草芽孢杆菌可改善汞引起的肠道微生物变化，降低鲤鱼的弧菌丰度和炎症。
text_zh: 富硒枯草芽孢杆菌可改善汞引起的肠道微生物变化，降低鲤鱼的弧菌丰度和炎症。
text_en: Selenium-enriched Bacillus subtilis can improve mercury-induced changes in gut microbiota, reducing Vibrio abundance and inflammation in carp.
outcome: 肠道微生物、弧菌丰度与炎症

quote: Liu et al. found that Pb accumulated in the gut causes dysbiosis of the microbiota, affects intestinal immunity and digestion, and damages the silver carp’s intestinal barrier [ 19 ].
statement: 肠道中蓄积的铅会导致微生物群失调，影响肠道免疫和消化，并损害鲢鱼的肠道屏障。
text_zh: 肠道中蓄积的铅会导致微生物群失调，影响肠道免疫和消化，并损害鲢鱼的肠道屏障。
text_en: Lead accumulated in the intestine causes microbiota dysbiosis, affects intestinal immunity and digestion, and damages the intestinal barrier of silver carp.
outcome: 肠道微生物群、肠道免疫、消化与肠道屏障

quote: Shi et al. suggested antibiotics administered to grass carp would exacerbate oxidative stress, lead dysbiosis of intestinal bacteria, inhibit the immune system of the mucosa, and activate apoptosis [ 20 ].
statement: 给草鱼施用抗生素会加剧氧化应激，导致肠道细菌失调，抑制黏膜免疫系统并激活细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 给草鱼施用抗生素会加剧氧化应激，导致肠道细菌失调，抑制黏膜免疫系统并激活细胞凋亡。
text_en: Administering antibiotics to grass carp exacerbates oxidative stress, leading to gut bacterial dysbiosis, suppression of the mucosal immune system, and activation of apoptosis.
outcome: 氧化应激、肠道细菌、黏膜免疫与细胞凋亡

quote: According to Qiao et al., poly-hydroxybutyrate may have beneficial effects on immunity and disease resistance through its interaction with the gut microbiota [ 21 ].
statement: 聚羟基丁酸酯可能通过与肠道微生物群的相互作用对免疫和抗病性产生有益影响。
text_zh: 聚羟基丁酸酯可能通过与肠道微生物群的相互作用对免疫和抗病性产生有益影响。
text_en: Polyhydroxybutyrate may have beneficial effects on immunity and disease resistance through interactions with the gut microbiota.

quote: We speculate that these immune-related genes could potentially modulate the immune response and may have a role in immune tolerance to commensal microbes, enabling 3nCC to exhibit stronger resistance to disease than 2nCC.
statement: 作者推测这些免疫相关基因可能调节免疫反应并在对共生微生物的免疫耐受中发挥作用，使三倍体金鱼（3nCC）比二倍体金鱼（2nCC）表现出更强的抗病能力。
text_zh: 作者推测这些免疫相关基因可能调节免疫反应并在对共生微生物的免疫耐受中发挥作用，使三倍体金鱼（3nCC）比二倍体金鱼（2nCC）表现出更强的抗病能力。
text_en: The authors speculate that these immune-related genes may regulate immune responses and play a role in immune tolerance to symbiotic microorganisms, resulting in triploid goldfish (3nCC) exhibiting stronger disease resistance than diploid goldfish (2nCC).

quote: Triploidization could modify the intestine microbiota and significantly increase the relative abundance of Vibro , which may, in turn, enhance disease resistance in 3nRR.
statement: 三倍体化可以改变肠道微生物群并显著增加弧菌的相对丰度，这反过来可能增强3nRR的疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 三倍体化可以改变肠道微生物群并显著增加弧菌的相对丰度，这反过来可能增强3nRR的疾病抵抗力。
text_en: Triploidization can alter the gut microbiota and significantly increase the relative abundance of Vibrio, which in turn may enhance the disease resistance of 3nRR.

quote: We also found that eight immunity-related genes have important implications in regulating immune response and may function in immune tolerance to commensal microbes, enabling 3nCC to exhibit a stronger resistance to disease than 2nCC.
statement: 研究发现八个免疫相关基因在调节免疫反应方面具有重要意义，并可能在针对共生微生物的免疫耐受中发挥作用，使3nCC比2nCC表现出更强的疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 研究发现八个免疫相关基因在调节免疫反应方面具有重要意义，并可能在针对共生微生物的免疫耐受中发挥作用，使3nCC比2nCC表现出更强的疾病抵抗力。
text_en: The study found that eight immune-related genes are important in regulating immune responses and may play a role in immune tolerance to symbiotic microorganisms, making 3nCC exhibit stronger disease resistance than 2nCC.

quote: By improving immune responses, systemic infections can be prevented [ 33 – 36 ].
statement: 通过改善免疫反应可以预防全身性感染。
text_zh: 通过改善免疫反应可以预防全身性感染。
text_en: Systemic infections can be prevented by improving immune responses.

quote: After euthanizing the fish with MS-222 (100 mg/L, Western Chemical, Inc., Ferndale, Washington), the intestinal tracts were dissected with sterile scissors.
statement: 用MS-222（100 mg/L）将鱼安乐死后，用无菌剪刀解剖肠道。
text_zh: 用MS-222（100 mg/L）将鱼安乐死后，用无菌剪刀解剖肠道。
text_en: After euthanizing the fish with MS-222 (100 mg/L), the intestines were dissected using sterile scissors.

quote: Each fish was injected with heparinized syringes to obtain its red blood cells from its caudal vein.
statement: 对每条鱼用肝素化注射器从尾静脉采血以获得红细胞。
text_zh: 对每条鱼用肝素化注射器从尾静脉采血以获得红细胞。
text_en: Blood was collected from the caudal vein of each fish using a heparinized syringe to obtain red blood cells.
